rapport_notes: Rep is warm, conversational, handles customer objections with humor and patience, though slightly rushed at the close.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after 'does that make sense?' — immediately continued with explanation rather than waiting for customer response.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'll just ask you a few questions to get us on the right track. Should just take a few minutes and then I will send everything over in your post kickoff email before we get started.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Do you have any specific concerns or questions that you'd like answers on this call in regards to the move?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised timing concern ('wanting to figure out...the timing cause obviously everybody does...by the hour'); rep acknowledged with 'Great' and 'Okay sure' but then immediately pivoted to logistics (storage unit details, floor level, distances) without probing deeper into the timing anxiety or asking 'what else is on your list?' Only one layer of engagement on the stated concern.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: No worries damage coverage which is a free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: You meet your mover feature. A few days before you move. You'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you help any attention of strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We do have our on time guarantee we do value your time. So if we can't make any time window that we arrange, we immi start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication_not_covered: No day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates mentioned anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: A typical move this size for a ten by fifteen internal unit usually takes between five and a half to seven and a half hours. Looks like the system quoted you within that range so it did quote you between seven or seven hours.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: If it was between six and seven hours...we would obviously just take-off that 200 so 1275. And again if you just decide to change your mind...if it takes us three and a half hours, then it takes us three and a half hours...if it takes long, you know, it takes less then that's just what you pay for.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: We like to give a range...we are super transparent in our weight, is just that hourly rate. If it takes long, you know, it takes less then that's just what you pay for.
evidence_quotes.close_missing: Call ends with 'I'm gonna send you this email with everything we went over and then if you do have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out.' No rate-lock statement ('your rate locks when you book'), no explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'), and customer was already booked online.

top_strength: Rep delivered a clear, transparent pricing explanation with all-inclusive details and anchored the time estimate to the job specifics (storage unit floor, distance, furniture size), building strong credibility.
coaching_note: Two critical gaps: (1) after the customer raised their timing concern as the priority, dig deeper with follow-ups instead of jumping straight to logistics probing—'tell me more about that' and 'what else matters to you on this call'; (2) Communication/day-before call element was never mentioned despite being a core differentiator, and Save Your Ass framing (especially 'does that feel fair?' followed by actual silence) was missing—use that pattern to lock confidence before the customer leaves.
